subject: Executive recap: Globex discovery — outcomes, risks, procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@globex.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps from today’s discovery (Globex)

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so your exec team has a single place to reference and so we can align on the procurement path. I kept this high level for leadership; Vivek and I will follow up with the technical deep-dive notes separately.

What we heard (pain & impact)
- High token spend and unpredictable latency on existing LLM endpoints for customer-facing features (search, summarization).
- Regulatory constraint: some analytics must stay inside the US and be deletable on request.
- Risk: current vendor has limited SLAs and no straightforward private deployment option, which worries operations and legal.

Desired business outcomes (top-line asks)
1) Reduce per-token cost by 40% for high-volume embed/generation workloads within 3 months of pilot.
2) Achieve 99.9% availability for customer-facing inference paths and <250ms median tail latency for short prompts.
3) Demonstrate private/VPC deployment with enforceable data residency and deletion controls for regulated customers.

Procurement path & timeline discussed
- Daniel to confirm internal exec sponsor (you), and provide procurement contact (Priya) — noted this morning.
- Globex aims to approve a pilot PO for Dedicated capacity (3 months) targeted by Apr 9, 2026.
- Post-pilot: standard conversion to annual committed capacity with SLA addendum.

Risks / open questions that need leadership input
- Confirmation on target budget band for pilot (ballpark) so we can size Dedicated capacity.
- Is Globex able to accept a standard Redwood DPA + SOC 2 attestation, or is a custom data clause required?
- Any constraints around onboarding times for procurement/legal reviews that we should escalate for priority?

Next steps (action owners)
- Daniel: Introduce Priya (procurement) on this thread and confirm pilot budget range (target: by Fri 3/19).
- Priya / Procurement: Request list of required legal/compliance docs.
- Vivek: Technical follow-up with proposed deployment topology + quick checklist for data deletion controls (ETA: EOD Thu 3/19).
- Marissa: Draft pilot SOW and commercial terms, share DocuSign link for PO (ETA: Mon 3/22).

Attachments: SOW_template_v1.pdf (draft commercial skeleton).

If this aligns, I’ll schedule a 30-minute exec briefing next week to lock the pilot PO and attendees.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today’s discovery (Globex)

Marissa — thanks for the crisp summary. This matches my notes. A few clarifying points from our side: 

- I’ll be the executive sponsor. Priya (copied) is the procurement lead who will own the PO. Priya — we’re looking at a 3-month pilot to validate performance and cost; ballpark budget for pilot is ~$75k depending on capacity sizing.
- Legal: we can accept standard attestation (SOC 2) but will need confirmation that we can restrict certain workloads to a private VPC and have the ability to trigger data deletion for flagged customer records.
- Timeline: Procurement has a calendar freeze the week of Mar 29 — we’d like to have the pilot PO processed before that.

I’ll coordinate with Priya and loop in our Legal once Vivek shares the deployment checklist.

Thanks —
Daniel
VP, Product Strategy
Globex Corporation

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Recap & next steps from today’s discovery (Globex)

Folks — tagging onto Marissa’s notes with a technical outline and risk mitigation plan. Attaching a simple diagram (deployment-arch.png).

Technical summary / feasibility
- Dedicated Redwood pool in us-west (single-tenant) to start; can restrict customer workloads via VPC peering and route table ACLs.
- KV-cache / prefix caching will be enabled for heavy summarization paths to reduce token spend; expect 30–50% reductions depending on prompt mix.
- For data deletion: we propose a customer identity mapping layer + per-customer deletion API that is covered in our standard DPA. We can also provide evented logs for deletion requests for audit.

Open technical risks
1) Integration effort for Globex’s existing identity mapping — expect 1–2 weeks of eng work during pilot.
2) If Globex requires air-gapped on-prem hosting for a subset of workloads, lead time is 6–8 weeks; this would be outside the standard pilot scope.

Ask from procurement/legal to unblock pilot
- Confirm which workload buckets require residency constraints.
- Signed NDA / access to a small sample dataset (anonymized) for performance validation.

Attachment: deployment-arch.png

—Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@globex.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@globex.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Executive summary for leadership: recommended path and escalation items

Daniel / Priya —

Following up with an executive-facing summary and a short list of items we’ll need from Globex to keep to the proposed timeline. This is intended to be sent to your procurement and legal leads as a one-page briefing.

Recommended pilot scope (what Redwood will deliver)- 12-week Dedicated capacity pilot in us-west, single-tenant, with prefix caching and token-optimization rules enabled for your high-volume flows.- Operational SLOs: 99.9% availability (business-hours monitoring window), 250ms median tail target for <128-token calls.- Compliance: SOC 2 attestation; DPA with data deletion API and audit logs; option to escalate to private on-prem for regulated customers (longer lead time).

Commercial ask- Pilot PO target: ~$75k (adjusted after capacity sizing call).- Standard Redwood terms with addendum for SLA and data residency; we will surface the SOW via DocuSign by Mon 3/22.

Escalation items for leadership
- Budget: If approval cannot meet the pilot figure, we need a contingency for a reduced-scope pilot (30 days) so we still validate core metrics.
- Legal: If your Legal requires bespoke DPA language beyond our standard, please flag the specific clauses by Fri 3/20 so we can prioritize legal review.
- Procurement calendar freeze week (Mar 29) — to meet this we should aim to finalize PO by Apr 5 at the latest.

Immediate asks (please reply inline)
1) Priya: Confirm procurement contact details and preferred PO process (email to procurement@globex.com? HubSpot PO intake?).
2) Daniel: Confirm exec attendees for a 30-min briefing next Tue/Wed (suggest Tue 3/23 10:00 PT).
3) Priya/Legal: Any must-have DPA language or compliance docs to route now?

I’ll pull the SOW into DocuSign (link in thread) and will coordinate the exec briefing once I have attendee confirmations.

Best —
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
